description: T-4584: sentinel cells around the sidecar pivot page-area capture window (snapshot.py pivot_area). Each PivX sheet holds one builder-v2 pivot at D12 (one data field, no axis field) with page fields: PivA 1 page (defaults); PivB 2 pages pageWrap 1 over-then-down; PivC 2 pages pageWrap 1 down-then-over; PivD 3 pages pageWrap 2 over-then-down; PivE 3 pages pageWrap 2 down-then-over; PivF 5 pages pageWrap 3 over-then-down (Product = A); PivG 5 pages pageWrap 3 down-then-over (Product (Multiple Items)); PivH 4 pages no wrap over-then-down; PivI 6 pages no wrap down-then-over (Region = West). BlankX!<a1> is =ISBLANK(PivX!<a1>) and TextX!<a1> is =PivX!<a1>&"" for every cell of rows 1-15, from column A to three columns past the expected window, so every cell within at least two rows and two columns of the window (clipped at row 1 and column A) is read by Excel.
